We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (requires SMILES? It says for a given SMILES string. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is implicit? The task likely expects we query the proton NMR of the sample at hand (no SMILES needed). The tool definitions: proton_nmr_spectra takes no parameters. So we can call it to get the 1H NMR. Then count methyl peaks (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbon signals. Simpler: get proton NMR.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
